ticket.title: S18-T README cleanup (owner m-8fe09cecd4): See it work shows all 7 video chapters; drop Why this architecture, How it works in one screen, and the Antivirus section
ticket.description:
The owner reviewed the root README.md (m-8fe09cecd4): "it looks like a mess". Up to "See it work" it is fine. Change the README as follows:

1. **"See it work" has half the chapters.** It shows 3 stills (pool, context, board), but the product video (S17, s-54a03afc5a) has 7 chapters. Show one still per chapter, all 7, in video order, each with the chapter's title and a one- or two-line caption.
   - Take each still from the rendered video's own frames or its Remotion scene at the chapter's key frame, in the Heronry palette with invented demo data.
   - Save them under docs/readme/storefront/ as still-N-<slug>.png, sized for GitHub, with each file ideally ≤ 300 KB.
   - Keep the intro line ("drawn in code … none is a screenshot").
2. **Delete "## Why this architecture" entirely**, including its four `docs/readme/why/*.png` images (they predate the rebrand). `git rm` the images if nothing else references them; grep the tree, site and docs first. Keep the linked docs (memory-layer.md, self-improvement.md, harnesses.md); link them from "## More" if they aren't linked there already.
3. **Delete "## How it works in one screen" entirely.** The presentation and the app already show the roles.
4. **Delete the "**Antivirus.**" block** under Heronry Desktop: the paragraph, the exclusions table and the controlled-folder paragraph. Also delete the Troubleshooting row "The antivirus removed the app". The owner's reason: the flag came from our agent's improper screenshot helper, and the antivirus never blocked the app. Keep any SmartScreen/Gatekeeper "unsigned installer" note that belongs to the install steps; that is a different, real prompt.
5. **Apply the same removals to the project site** (S15, MkDocs) and the docs wherever the same text or images appear, so README and site agree.
6. **Check:**
   - every remaining README link and image resolves (a link check);
   - the PII gate passes (`python .github/scripts/pii_gate.py`);
   - `mkdocs build --strict` passes if the site changed;
   - the rendered README reads top to bottom with no orphaned references to removed sections.

**Rules:** commit by path with both trailers; no fleet restarts. Report a before/after outline plus the 7 stills as the evidence (artifact_upload the stills), then record_status and close_self.
